articles.title: Hackers Hit Supermarket Fridges Across Europe
articles.summary: Hackers raised fridge temperatures at dozens of European stores, spoiling food, and no one has claimed responsibility.

articles.title: Judge Orders Release of Canadian Dentist Held in Minnesota
articles.summary: A judge ruled Dr. William Lizardo's detention broke his rights and ordered him released; he now awaits a green card decision.

articles.title: Supreme Court Says California Can Keep Counting Its Ballots
articles.summary: The Supreme Court denied a request to set aside 20,000 California ballots, leaving lower-court rulings in place.
